title: Jammy Chewy Energizing Vietnamese Tarragon Bun Rieu
description: A unique, energizing twist on the classic Vietnamese noodle soup, featuring long-fermentation-dough and fresh tarragon leaves. Perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: Long-fermentation-dough
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, fermented for at least 24 hours.

instructions: In a large pot, combine vegetable broth, ginger, and garlic. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add palm sugar, coconut oil, and egg whites to the pot. Whisk until palm sugar dissolves.
Add long-fermentation-dough to the pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until dough is fully cooked.
Add tarragon leaves, fermented tofu, scallions, and cilantro to the pot. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until leaves are wilted.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with pickled ginger.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Portion into individual servings and serve immediately.
Use leftover dough to make fresh bun rieu for snacking or dessert.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
